14.3.eg: Main deck without loose rust scale.
14.3.fg: Main deck na walang maluwag na kalawang.
fc: Tuktukin at pinturahan ang may makapal na kalawang; linisin ang cargo residues
fx: Deck na walang maluwag na kalawang.
ff: Maluwag na kalawang sa main deck

14.4.eg: Deck pipes without pitting, soft patches, clamps, leaks.
ex: Deck pipes without corrosion, holes or temporary repairs.
14.4.fg: Deck pipes na walang pitting, soft patches, clamps, leaks.
fc: Fire, ballast, air, hydraulic at steam lines sa deck – walang temporary repair
fx: Deck pipes na walang kalawang, butas o temporary repair.
ff: Deck pipes na may clamps / doublers / leak

14.5.eg: Weathertight doors, fire doors, portholes, wheelhouse windows in good condition.
ex: Doors (watertight, fire, weathertight), portholes and bridge windows in good condition.
14.5.fg: Maayos ang weathertight doors, fire doors, portholes, wheelhouse windows.
fc: Maayos ang door dogs at goma; sumasara nang kusa ang fire doors, hindi naka-wedge nang bukas
Kumpleto ang deadlights; walang bitak ang bintana
fx: Maayos ang mga pinto (watertight, fire, weathertight), portholes at bintana ng bridge.
ff: Sira ang seals ng weathertight door, naninigas ang dogs

14.6.eg: Air pipes & vents: condition, closing devices, MARKING of space served.
ex: Vents and air pipes in good condition, marked with the space they serve.
14.6.fg: Air pipes at vents: kondisyon, closing devices, MARKA ng space na sineserbisyuhan.
fc: Bawat air pipe head may marka ng tank na sineserbisyuhan; OK ang floats/balls (chine-check ng Class)
Walang pagkabulok sa dugtong sa deck
fx: Maayos ang vents at air pipes, may marka ng space na sineserbisyuhan.
ff: Air pipes at vents na walang marka ng space / naninigas o wala ang closing devices

14.8.fg: Tama ang marka ng hatch numbers.
fc: Kita ang numero sa magkabilang gilid

14.9.eg: Masts, stays, flood/deck/emergency/hold lights working (inspector will switch them on).
ex: Masts, stays and lights (deck, flood, emergency, hold) working.
14.9.fg: Gumagana ang masts, stays, flood/deck/emergency/hold lights (bubuksan ito ng inspector).
fc: Subukan lahat ng deck lights at hold lights bago ang inspection
Hindi kalawangin ang mast fittings
fx: Gumagana ang masts, stays at ilaw (deck, flood, emergency, hold).
ff: Hindi gumagana ang deck / flood lights (binubuksan ito ng inspector)

14.10.eg: Portable cargo lights: non-conductive holder/shade, isolation, inspections.
ex: Portable and fixed hold lights inspected and in good condition.
Lamp holder, drip shield and shade not made of non-conductive material
14.10.fg: Portable cargo lights: non-conductive ang holder/shade, isolation, inspections.
fc: Non-conductive ang lamp holder, drip shield at shade
Buo ang cables/plugs; inspection records
fx: Na-inspect at maayos ang portable at fixed hold lights.
Hindi non-conductive ang lamp holder, drip shield at shade
ff: Portable cargo lights na may metal shade / walang isolation / sira ang cables

14.11.eg: Electrical on deck/accommodation: sockets, junction boxes, cables in good condition.
ex: Electrical installations on deck and in accommodation in good condition.
14.11.fg: Electrical sa deck/accommodation: maayos ang sockets, junction boxes, cables.
fc: Walang sirang takip, nakalantad na wire, kulang na glands
Weathertight sockets na may takip
fx: Maayos ang electrical sa deck at accommodation.

14.12.eg: Paint store, battery room, O2/acetylene rooms: ventilation, Ex-proof lights, fire extinguishing, signs.
ex: Chemicals and gases correctly stored, and stores with ventilation, Ex-proof lights and fire extinguishing.
14.12.fg: Paint store, battery room, O2/acetylene rooms: ventilation, Ex-proof lights, fire extinguishing, signs.
fc: Ex-proof lights at fans; extinguishing system
Hiwalay at naka-secure ang chemicals
Warning signs; vent at eyewash sa battery room
fx: Tama ang imbakan ng chemicals at gas, at may ventilation, Ex-proof lights at fire extinguishing ang stores.
ff: Sira ang sprinkler o ventilation ng paint store / hindi Ex-proof ang ilaw / walang ventilation ang battery room

14.13.fg: Malinis, maayos at naka-secure ang stores (accommodation at deck).
fc: Maayos at naka-secure ang bosun store, provision stores

14.15.eg: Galley & accommodation electrical appliances in good condition.
ex: Galley appliances and electrical items in accommodation in good condition.
14.15.fg: Maayos ang galley at electrical appliances sa accommodation.
fc: Walang sirang cables/plugs; galley range guards, fire blanket
fx: Maayos ang gamit sa galley at electrical sa accommodation.

14.16.eg: Refrigerated rooms: door seals, catches, alarm (man-trapped).
ex: Cold rooms with seals, catches and alarm in good condition.
14.16.fg: Refrigerated rooms: door seals, catches, alarm (man-trapped).
fc: Subukan ang man-trapped alarm at inside release
fx: Maayos ang seals, catches at alarm ng cold rooms.

ex: Elevator inspected and in good condition.
14.17.fg: Na-inspect at may certificate ang elevator.
fc: Inspection certificate; emergency stop/phone

14.18.eg: Hospital equipped, clean, for medical use only.
ex: Hospital equipped, clean, for medical use only.
14.18.fg: Kumpleto ang gamit, malinis, at para lang sa medical ang hospital.
fc: Hindi ginagamit na bodega; hindi expired ang medicine chest inventory
fx: Kumpleto ang gamit, malinis, at para lang sa medical ang hospital.

14.19.eg: Guard rails, walkways, ladders, steps in good condition – no hanging chains.
ex: Railings, walkways, ladders in good condition.
14.19.fg: Maayos ang guard rails, walkways, ladders, steps – walang nakalaylay na kadena.
fc: Walang bulok/sirang rails; mahigpit ang kadena sa pagitan ng stanchions
Hindi bulok ang ladders at steps
fx: Maayos ang railings, walkways at hagdan.
Nakalaylay na kadena sa pagitan ng stanchions
ff: Bulok o sira ang handrails / kadena imbes na rails

15.1.eg: SEA per MLC, wages ≥ ILO minimum, monthly wage statements, no illegal deductions.
ex: SEA per MLC, wages at least the ILO minimum, monthly account.
If there is an ITF/CBA, he does not check wages
15.1.fg: SEA ayon sa MLC, sahod ≥ ILO minimum, monthly wage statements, walang ilegal na kaltas.
fc: May pirmadong kopya ng SEA; CBA/ITF kung meron
Binibigyan ang crew ng monthly wage accounts
Walang kaltas para sa pamasahe/recruitment
fx: SEA ayon sa MLC, sahod hindi bababa sa ILO minimum, buwanang account.
Kung may ITF/CBA, hindi niya chine-check ang sahod

15.2.eg: Accommodation: cleanliness, Master's weekly inspection records.
ex: Accommodation safe, clean, with regular inspections.
15.2.fg: Accommodation: kalinisan, weekly inspection records ng Master.
fc: Weekly inspection records ng Master (finding kung wala)
Malinis ang cabins, toilets, laundry; gumagana ang ventilation/ilaw
fx: Ligtas at malinis ang accommodation, may regular na inspection.
Walang weekly inspection records ng Master

fc: Gym, TV, internet; patunay ng welfare budget

15.5.eg: Food & water free of charge, qualified cook, potable water tests.
ex: Enough food and water free of charge, and a qualified cook.
Water analysis less than 2 times a year
Writes the food budget per person per day
15.5.fg: Libre ang pagkain at tubig, qualified ang cook, potable water tests.
fc: Libreng inuming tubig (hindi lang bottled na binebenta)
Potable water analysis ≥ dalawang beses kada taon
Cook certificate; kalinisan ng galley; alam ang food budget
fx: Sapat at libreng pagkain at tubig, at qualified na cook.
Water analysis na mas mababa sa 2 beses kada taon
Isinusulat ang food budget bawat tao bawat araw

15.6.eg: Medical care & doctor visits without delay.
ex: Medical care and doctor/dentist in port without delay.
15.6.fg: Medical care at pagpapatingin sa doktor nang walang delay.
fc: Medical log; medicine chest; records ng doctor visit
fx: Medical care at doktor/dentista sa pantalan nang walang delay.

15.9.eg: Violence/harassment policy communicated to the crew.
ex: A policy against violence and harassment, known by the crew.
15.9.fg: Naipaalam sa crew ang policy laban sa violence/harassment.
fc: Nakapaskil ang policy sa common language; na-brief ang crew
fx: May policy laban sa karahasan at harassment, alam ng crew.
ff: Hindi naipaalam ang policy sa wika ng crew / hindi alam ng crew ang complaint process

ex: A mental health policy and training.
fc: Nakapaskil ang policy; training records ng key personnel
fx: May mental health policy at training.

ex: Free and confidential access to external support.
15.11.fg: Confidential na access sa external support (helplines).
fc: Nakapaskil ang helpline posters (hal. SeafarerHelp)
fx: Libre at confidential na access sa external support.

15.12.eg: Mental health training for key personnel.
ex: Training of key personnel to recognise signs of mental health problems.
15.12.fg: Mental health training para sa key personnel.
fc: Certificates ng mental health awareness training
fx: Training ng key personnel para makilala ang palatandaan ng mental health problems.

ex: AHU with comfortable temperature and maintenance and cleaning records.
fc: Nalinis ang AHU filters; maintenance records
fx: AHU na komportable ang temperatura at may records ng maintenance at paglilinis.
